rationale: This is a pure functional-form tweak of the incumbent champion (graded rank weight replaced by a median indicator on the identical conditioner and identical valuation leg), so it is a cosmetic variant that will be near-perfectly rank-correlated with the existing signal within the retained half and adds no new economic content.

Adding spot and five-year-average operating profit is just the arithmetic midpoint of two already-tested anchors in the same family (spot t=3.33, MA t=3.55, plus MIN and MAX envelopes), and since MA(oiadp,5) and oiadp are highly correlated the blend is guaranteed to land between them — an interpolation, not a test of a new mechanism.

Swapping IND_ZSCORE for IND_RANK on the valuation leg is a normalization choice rather than an economic hypothesis, and while it genuinely reshuffles the short leg, it is the same two variables in the same multiplicative form as the champion and belongs in a robustness appendix, not as a new cross-theme signal.

The direction-of-travel of capital intensity is a genuinely untested dimension of the family's most productive conditioner and the expression matches the stated sign, but the reviewer should note that a falling dp/at is also a low-investment/asset-shrinkage proxy closely related to the asset-growth anomaly that FF5's CMA leg already spans, so a weak ls_alpha would be unsurprising and the hypothesis's "transitioning to asset-light" reading is only one of several interpretations.

Subtracting a one-year change in the dollar debt stock from a five-year average profit flow mixes incommensurate quantities whose scales differ by an order of magnitude, so the valuation leg will be dominated by net debt issuance scaled by market cap — effectively rediscovering the well-documented net debt issuance / external financing anomaly rather than testing a value-quality interaction.

The conditioner is the net share issuance anomaly (Pontiff–Woodgate, Daniel–Titman, and the composite-issuance literature), a first-order standalone predictor whose known sign will drive most of the product's slope, and it is mechanically correlated with the valuation leg because repurchases shrink csho and hence the market-cap denominator — so a positive result would not identify the claimed "buybacks at low multiples" interaction.
